create_InferenceClient: create an InferenceClient instance with an HF_TOKEN environment variable for API authentication
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion request using InferenceClient.chat.completions.create with a model and user messages
run_conversational_llm: run a conversational LLM inference call to meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and print the assistant response
build_llm_query: build a conversational LLM query with a user message asking about the capital of France
test_chat_response: test the chat completion response by accessing completion.choices[0].message from the InferenceClient call
